messages.subject: Re: R-INLA is now built with R-4.6
messages.subject_clean: R-INLA is now built with R-4.6
messages.body_plain:
Dear Håvard,

There is no windows binary for R 4.6.
Furthermore we often get warnings like
Warning: unable to access index for repository https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.6:
  cannot open URL 'https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable/bin/windows/contrib/4.6/PACKAGES'

Best regards,

Thierry
